title: Derived direct image preserves coproducts of complexes with a fixed annihilator
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with finite torsion etale cohomological dimension $\kuncd(f)<\infty$ [def-kun-cd]. Let $\Lambda$ be any commutative ring and let $n\geq1$ be an integer. Work in the ordinary unbounded derived categories of sheaves of modules over the constant ring sheaves on the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and use the total K-injective direct image $Rf_*$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. For every family $(K_i)_{i\in I}$ indexed by a set small in the coefficient-module universe, assume $n\cdot\mathrm{id}_{K_i}=0$ in $D(X_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ for every $i$. Then the canonical comparison
$$\bigoplus_{i\in I}Rf_*K_i\longrightarrow Rf_*\left(\bigoplus_{i\in I}K_i\right),$$
whose composite with the $i$-th coprojection is $Rf_*(\iota_i)$, is an isomorphism in $D(Y_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$. The family may be empty and the complexes may be unbounded in both directions; no torsion, finiteness or Noetherianity assumption is made on $\Lambda$.

source.place: Tag 0F11, lemma-finite-cd-mod-n-direct-sums (1), extended from Z/n coefficients to objects annihilated by n over an arbitrary coefficient ring. Agent formulation, not the literal statement of 0F11.

external.place: Tag 0D6J, lemma-modules-abelian-unbounded (3), comparison of total direct images after forgetting coefficients.

proof.text: For every coefficient ring B, the ordinary coefficient-forgetting functor preserves all coproducts by lem-weil-pbc-constant-module-sheaves-forget-colimits. Apply the exact-derived-coproduct theorem lem-pur-exact-derived-coproducts to obtain preservation of unbounded derived coproducts. The unbounded comparison lem-kun-unbounded-abelian-exchange-comparison, specialized to the identity vertical square, makes derived forgetting conservative and identifies U_Y Rf_B with Rf_ab U_X naturally. Additivity transports n id=0 to A_i=U_X K_i.

Represent an arbitrary abelian derived object A annihilated by n by a complex I of injective sheaves using lem-pur-kinjective-degreewise-existence. The existing adjunction forget: Mod(Z/n) -> Ab, coind=Hom_Z(Z/n,-), gives a complex L=coind(I). Its counit has, sectionwise, image exactly the kernel of multiplication by n; this is the proved source declaration forget₂CoindZModAdj_counit_shortExact in WeilConjectures.CategoryTheory.Sites.CoinduceZMod. Its injectivity is also part of that declaration. Exactness passes from presheaves to sheaves by exact sheafification. Multiplication by n on every injective term is epic by lem-trf-injective-abelian-sheaf-divisible. Thus 0 -> U(L) -> I -> I -> 0 is degreewise short exact, with second map n id.

The short exact sequence yields the distinguished triangle Q U(L) -> QI -> QI -> Q U(L)[1]. The second map is zero since QI is isomorphic to A and n id_A=0. The representable exact sequence of the triangle therefore lifts id_QI through its first map, producing a section. This is proved directly using Mathlib CategoryTheory.Pretriangulated.Triangle.coyoneda_exact₂, the representable exactness consequence of the pretriangulated axioms. The exact-functor localization comparison identifies Q U(L) with U Q(L). Transport through A isomorphic to QI to obtain a retract of U Q(L) onto A. This constructs the Z/n complex and both retract maps explicitly; no object is chosen from an unproved mere existence theorem.

Apply lem-kun-0f11 to the family Q(L_i). Step 1 with B=Z/n identifies the canonical abelian comparison on U Q(L_i) as invertible: the comparison for a composite functor is the comparison for the second functor followed by its image of the comparison for the first, and comparisons are invariant under natural isomorphism. Both equations hold on every coprojection, hence follow from the coproduct universal property.

Write j_i:A_i -> C_i and r_i:C_i -> A_i for the retract in Step 3. The coproduct comparison beta is natural in the family. Consequently its inverse for A is Rf_ab(sum j_i) followed by inverse(beta_C) followed by sum Rf_ab(r_i), in Lean composition order. The two inverse identities follow from naturality for j and r and from sum j_i followed by sum r_i being identity. All these equations are proved by coproduct extensionality and functoriality.

Apply Step 1 for B=Lambda once more. The abelian coproduct property reflects through the conservative coproduct-preserving forgetful functor, proving invertibility of exactly sigmaComparison in the unchanged statement. No common cohomology bound is used. The proof covers empty families; for n=1 the coinduced complex and the annihilated input are zero. No assumption on Lambda is introduced.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0F11(1), combined with 0D6J(3). U3 uses the dual kernel/coinduction construction: divisibility from sites-cohomology.tex Tag 0DD7 and the degreewise-injective resolution replace K-flat derived quotient cones; all assembly is proved in Lean.
